{{emote|舔了舔嘴唇}}
我的渴归我，你的水归你。
渴。水。饮。
咂嘴的时候到了。
我的水即渴，你的水即你的。

conversation.choice: 我在旅途中遇到一个族群——斯林斯，他们正在寻找新家。
我看斯林斯已经到了。他们过得怎么样？
一周过去了。斯林斯安顿好了吗？

start.text: There are no more words for us, wanderer.
=name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.
=name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.
start.choice: I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

node.text: 啊！告诉我，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=，它是否正如我心中所见的那幅奇景？你是否被它的真理击中了美？
node.choice: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!
To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!
I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?

node.text: 那么是真的！哦，银之父，你们的作为何其深远！……那我的小饰物呢？你把它投进圣井了吗？
node.choice: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.

node.text: 月与日！银之父祝福我们，我们的道路镀了铬，闪闪发亮。谢谢你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。愿贝尔护佑你。
哦，这消息让我沉重如铅。可你的朝圣仍使我宽慰。月与日，我仍感到卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）的温暖。赞美银之父。
哦，你的话如何刮擦着我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你把我磨伤了。我们别再谈了。
那么你已见过真理？我们银之父的机巧何其宏大！我们的相遇，是一支小小的颂歌。命运凭他们的意志与话语，在我们的影子里起舞。月与日，多好的一天！多好的一天。赞美舍金纳！
什——听你这么说，我心中的光泽黯淡了。你磨伤了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我起了划痕。那我的小饰物呢？你把它投进了……「地上的洞」？
node.choice: Yes, I threw it in the hole.
I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.

node.text: 嗯……卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）的光仍透过你粗砺的棱边闪烁。那么我必须谢谢你。
这消息的冲击让我的胃翻搅颤抖。若你的轻慢中有可学的教训，我会在自己的时间里细想。我们别再谈了。
啊，我胃下裂开一个坑！我求你，我们别再谈了。你把我蹭花了。活着，畅饮。

start.text: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?
start.choice: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

start.text: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
start.choice: What is the Six Day Stilt?

node.text: 啊！那座玻璃的机械教派大神殿、神圣的奉献之井，以及石浮雕上的历史。银之父以雕像与光塑之形居于其间。四周环绕着大集市。我听说那里的人比虚空中的数目还多，他们的喧哗汇成一种对世界而言全然生涩而崭新的声音。你愿意去那里，带上我的小玩意吗？你愿意在井边替我奉献它吗——那是我去不了的地方？
node.choice: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

node.text: 是的！我的邻族已经听腻了这个故事。我当时正在割藤，刀面从土里翻出了什么东西。从前见到铬，我的心也悸动过，可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……那么你愿意去吗？在井边奉献我的小玩意？
node.choice: What is the Six Day Stilt again?
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

node.text: 你要明白，我并非教长，但他们是铬的铸造者——舍金纳之下的诸神，从原初的卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）中锻出金属的宏构。你愿意去吗？
node.choice: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

node.text: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!
node.choice: What is the Six Day Stilt?
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

node.text: 朋友，我会被黎明滑翔蜥的光线烤成一堆闷燃的焦炭！我会被伊萨卡里的步枪打成满是蛞蝓的尸首！大荒漠里没有仁慈，峡谷里也多不了几分。我去了就活不成。
node.choice: What is the Six Day Stilt again?
I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

node.text: 月与日，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！我向你致以深切而多面的谢意。来，现在就把这小玩意拿去。若你还会回来，我们再见。活着，畅饮！
是的！我的邻族已经听腻了这个故事。我当时正在割藤，刀面把它从土里翻了出来。从前见到铬，我的心也悸动过，可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，在「美」的算盘上把一颗珠子拨向横梁……那么你愿意去吗？在井边奉献我的小玩意？
是的！我的邻族已经听腻了这个故事。我当时正在喝夏天的下水杂烩，忽然看见肠腑间有什么在闪光。从前见到铬，我的心也悸动过，可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……那么你愿意去吗？在井边奉献我的小玩意？
朋友，我会被黎明滑翔蜥的光线烤成一堆闷燃的焦炭！我会被伊萨卡里的步枪打成满是蛞蝓的尸首！大荒漠里没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。
是的！我的邻族已经听腻了这个故事。我当时正从一面旗幡上拧水，脚下在盐层里踢到了什么。从前见到铬，我的心也悸动过，可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……那么你愿意去吗？在井边奉献我的小玩意？
朋友，我会被黎明滑翔蜥的光线烤成一堆闷燃的焦炭！我会被我亲族的步枪打成满是蛞蝓的尸首！大荒漠深处没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。
是的！我的邻族已经听腻了这个故事。我是从一堆猪粪里把它捞出来的。从前见到铬，我的心也悸动过，可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，在「美」的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……那么你愿意去吗？在井边奉献我的小玩意？
朋友，我会被黎明滑翔蜥的光线烤成一堆闷燃的焦炭！我会被伊萨卡里的步枪打成满是蛞蝓的尸首！大荒漠里没有仁慈。我去了就活不成。

text.text: ——唔。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=。
{{emote|*长者伊鲁达微笑。*}}
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}} 进来——到凉荫底下来坐，坐那儿的垫子上。
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}} 活着，畅饮，=name=。来，坐我旁边。

start.text: 嗯——。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}} 活着，畅饮。进来——到凉荫底下来坐，坐那儿的垫子上。欢迎来到约帕（Joppa）。你也可饮我们的淡水，解解渴。

choice.IfFinishedQuestStep: What's Eating the Watervine?~Travel to Red Rock

start.choice: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?
Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?
What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?
Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.

node.text: 这个呀？绿洲小村。在世界之台底下。风从大盐漠莫格拉伊上吹来百万口咸气。往东，是卡德（Qud）腐朽的丛林。就在这两者之间的缝里——水藤能长，我们就种它。嗯——，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
node.choice: Can you tell me about Qud?

node.text: 嗯——，那边？地势向上斜，长满铬色的尖塔——不老的物件。它们俯瞰着旧世的隧道，枕在腐朽的丛林与菌林之上。而北面的山峦把它们撞碎了，就在纺锤（the Spindle）的阴影里……那里有人，有朋友，有社群。也有谁都不认的朋友。历史浓得像高盐的日头，=player.formalAddressTerm=；在往昔被磨成马兹粉的地方，一种混成的生命便扎下根来。嗯——，有胆气的人便出发去寻自己的那一小片遗物。去迎那两位命运——生与死……
-here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.
嗯——，活儿？农人们被洞穴害虫缠得苦。你可以去跟那边的梅赫梅特谈谈，就在南边那片水藤地旁。还有阿盖夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总在找能接线的小玩意，嘿。穿过他那间铁皮小屋，在西南边。
-mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.
-ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.
-mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.
这个呀？哦？哦……{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老停顿了好几分钟。*}} 长疣的腿？嗯。酸树脂的臭气？嗯——。月与日……一个格尔什幼体？这是个格尔什幼体。
瘟疫的造物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯——。这一个……{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老停顿。*}} 这一个满身黏液，是从沉睡的阿戈尔戈特（Agolgot）的污水管里挤出来的，就在下水道下的洞穴里……嗯——，可在这儿？格尔什幼体跑到这么西边？要有一只到得了这里，就得有上百只……嗯，环流又在扩张了吗？？
node.choice: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

node.text: {{emote|*伊鲁达德长老停顿。*}} 嗯——，瘟疫。我们不知多少代之前的高祖们的瘟疫。盐、黑暗、斯瓦迪姆蛙……格尔什幼体。
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老停顿。*}} 嗯——，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不愿用一句粗话把空气弄酸！可这消息像酸液一样咬我的肝。嗯，得向尼玛讨一副藜麦药剂……
node.choice: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.
There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...
I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.
I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.

node.text: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老停顿。*}} 嗯——，拿非利。第七瘟疫。生在月梯上的格尔什泰坦，被催活过来吃我们的幼崽。苏丹雷谢夫在千年前把它们赶了回去，赶去沉睡。嗯，它们要醒了吗？
-mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.
嗯——？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你的发现对我们价值丰厚。我们是穷农夫，能做的只有磨快割藤刀。可别人呢？也许能给更多。收下这些刺礼，算是谢意。嗯，我不会很快忘记这件事，=name=。现在让我安静地想一想吧，好心人……
嗯——，是吧？千年前的瘟疫。共七场：格尔什幼体、黑暗。嗯，斯瓦迪姆蛙……啊，还有拿非利，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吃亲族幼崽的格尔什泰坦。苏丹雷谢夫把它们赶到了地下，可它们还在动吗？？

conversation.node: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?

node.text: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.

conversation.node: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.
Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.

node.text: 嗯——，你那些发亮的朋友们安顿得相当好。有些人还有些倦怠的阴云，可任何一批勇敢的迁徙者都是如此。啊，他们终会找到自己的立脚处或自己的路，只是需要时间。有些农人显出一点小小的不安，但那会随时间过去。
嗯——，啊，=name=。来看看黏液人如何成了约帕（Joppa）的一部分！有些人不在意我们生活的慢节奏，自己出去闯了；凭他们的筋腱与头脑，我毫不怀疑他们会活着找到目的。嗯，另一些则欢迎在我们的沼泽里生长繁盛。

start.text: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?

choice.IfFinishedQuestStep: What's Eating the Watervine?~Travel to Red Rock

start.choice: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.

text.text: 活下去，喝足水，=name=。
=name=，尝得出今天风里是什么味儿吗？
日月在上，=name=。
=name=，我尝得出石灰。说不定还有镓？
是啊，除害的人！活下去，喝足水，=name=。

start.text: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.
start.choice: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
I am in search of work.

node.text: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.
Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.
大荒漠吹来的风凉了一点，也吐出些水气。刚刚够。一条舌头能尝出上百种风，你懂吧？总之，我走神时就去那儿。至于约帕（Joppa）更多的消息，我说你去找我们的长老朋友。伊鲁达德。沿路往北。
是吧？那我就说了。有东西在啃我们的水藤，就在甲虫月前后。Q-鲁恩说他见过一只蜘蛛样的生物，在盐水里潜行。可没有洞穴蜘蛛敢靠看守的踩踏处那么近。我在水洼里尝到一点红色碎屑。是页岩，像我们在红岩边的土里找到的那种……
你能走去那儿吗？去红岩。就在约帕（Joppa）往北约两帕拉桑（parasang）。杀掉那些害虫，带一具尸体回来，好看看它是什么。事后长老会付你报酬的，水之手。
node.choice: I will do as you ask.

node.text: Aye.
哦？哦。{{emote|*梅赫梅特停顿。*}} 我不喜欢那东西的样子。最好拿去给长老。他的小屋沿路往北。
=generic=

start.text: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?
start.choice: What kind of creature are you?
I desire nothing. Live and drink.

node.text: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.
约帕（Joppa）是我的家，没错。我曾随着我族人同盐背的商队走过莫格拉（Moghra'yi），但一见到长老伊鲁达德，我当下就知道该在此安顿下来。=player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=，你若同他谈过，就会明白。
I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?
My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.
=player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?
node.choice: What kind of creature are you?
I desire nothing. Live and drink.

node.text: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?
嘘！嘿，有兴趣看看财团的货吗？

text.text: 欢迎来约帕（Joppa），朋友。你安分，咱就是朋友，嘿？你要惹事，我的活儿就是把你像条鳄鱼那样剖开。
长老在我右肩后头，药师在左边。我请你挑一个，要么就转身走。我不是来闲聊的。
活下去，喝足水，外乡来的。
{{emote|*亚拉梅哼了一声。*}}
{{emote|*亚拉梅点点头。*}}
那接下来呢？
看饱了，嘿？
嗯。他们还没把你结果掉。

node.choice: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.
I depart for Grit Gate soon.
I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

node.text: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.
Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.
Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.
Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.
Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.
If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?

text.text: 啊，一张新面孔。我是尼玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。你若打算往卡德（Qud）去，出发前会需要些我的货。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。
治伤最可靠的方子是时间与休息，但你若赶时间，我的货能帮上忙。
愿命运看顾你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
别让路上的药瓶空了。你需要的东西我这儿有。

node.text: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?

I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.
node.choice: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?

node.text: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.

text.text: 活下去，喝足水，旅人。带点水润的星苹果上路？
看着点那些树，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们不是你的。
你可别盯着我家小子看，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
星苹果错不了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你哪儿不舒服它都管用。
你会做星苹果酱吗？不会就跟我买。
把星苹果抹在你的无酵饼上！既防渴，也防伤。
看见我这胡子没？星苹果。它能把你的雄风提三倍。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。你饿吗？
去弄猪泥。泥？
咋？
当心猪留下的东西，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
你可别去弄坏我的篱笆。
你最好别伤我的牲口。
我不是脏。我是沾了泥。差别大着呢。
要么在这儿买肉，要么冒着肚子挨一记弹鼻的风险。你自己挑，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
上好的干净肉！嗯。也就干净到这份上。
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
别担心。我的蟹温顺得像狗。
想靠近就靠近，它们不夹人。
你在野外遇到过这种吗？为了一条蟹腿，有人能跑多远啊！
这些小家伙每一个都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是奢华日子。
紧张过的蟹，肉就柴。买驯化肉。
它们不可爱吗？可爱的小东西。
我的蟹温顺得不能再温顺。也好吃得很。
他们说我们最终都会变成蟹。
要什么吗？
嗯。
味儿的事，抱歉。
当心血洼。
不骗你，我爱我这活儿。
水蛭。血。你要的是这个，我就有你要的。
我拿牧场主们多余的血喂这些小家伙。
抱歉。走了下神。你需要什么？
血的味道还行，但我没法想象靠它活着。
以食者（the Eaters）之名，我累垮了。我能帮你什么吗？
请不要开那道门。
我求你。别把猫放出来。
你有什么最亮闪闪的东西，只要肯卖，我就买。
我是牧猫人。我父母是牧猫人。他们的父母是牧猫人，再上一辈也是。我不明白我们为什么要做这件事，但这是我会的全部。
你若需要，我这儿有一缕微光可卖，游荡者。
猫不卖。
这热天快把我热晕了。
脚下当心！哈哈哈！
简单的人养简单的生物。我不介意。
祝福这一团糟，也祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我能为你做什么？要黏液吗？
你灌过一口黏液吗？味道还真不赖！
我让我的变形虫过得开心！或者说，它们拿什么替代开心的那个东西。
看它们的皮在盐日下怎么发亮？真好看。
你可别把我的变形虫戳破。
我想我把水洼都收拾干净了，但还是留神黏液。
进来吧。躲一躲这盐。
人手能造出怎样的迷宫与曼陀罗，竟妄想超越自然在我们被造之前的万古里所造就的东西？
蜗牛壳上的纹路何等崇高。而「纹路」这个词又多么可爱。
我常想起雷谢夫福音里的那个「环流（Gyre）」。你猜它为什么叫这个名字？
即便在螺旋壳的不完美处，我们也看得见自然的完美。
我的蜗牛不太适应这气候。有些日子，我为了保持它们够黏滑所花的水，比卖出去挣的还多。
蜗牛会觉得别的壳上的螺旋熟悉而安适。你若戴上一只，它们会对你另眼相看。
软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知道什么我们所不知道的秘密？
你要什么。
羊腿肉耐放。回盐地之前买点吧。
怎么，还要菜单？我有羊腿肉和羊肉干。
我恨我的羊，它们也恨我，但我们更恨其他所有人。
鬼天气，糟透了。你要什么？
卖肉。
带羊赶路没意思，但它们是好的护卫。
这日子不是我求来的，可我们就到这儿了。要买点什么吗？
有人嫌甲虫肉干太酸。我说，学做饭去！
看它们的甲壳！看见那层光吗？那说明它们健康。
甲虫是好伙伴，但别把背包和你那只宠物甲虫留在同一间屋里。
甲虫肉没什么不好。来，尝尝。
甲虫肉干自有它的好。你会学着欣赏那余味。
鲜肉与腌肉，一应俱全，价钱公道。
来看我的牲口？全都健壮、喂得饱，我向你保证。
活下去，吃足蜜。
哦，看。这是一只非熊。你好，非熊。
活下去，喝足水，小朋友。
我会很享受一些蜂蜜。
{{emote|*哼哼*}}
{{emote|*抽鼻子*}}
{{emote|*喷气*}}
{{emote|*沉重的叹息*}}
{{emote|*叹息*}}
哎呀，多可爱的一只非熊。你好，可爱的非熊。
哦。
嗯。
嗯。哦！你好。
是？
不好意思。
哦。活下去，喝足水，非熊。
我决定不了自己最喜欢哪样：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？我就是决定不了。
光鱼不是最好吃的食物，但它们是最漂亮的。
我曾翻过一座山，以为过了山顶就能看见我从未见过的东西。结果我很失望：山的另一面与我刚离开的那一面惊人地相似。山的意义是什么？

node.choice: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

text.text: 唔。
猎物。
嗯嗯嗯呃。
我饿了。
活下去，还有……被吃掉。
{{emote|*舔了舔嘴唇*}}
肉。
{{emote|*默默地点头*}}
嘘。听。
活着，畅饮。
我是和平的。
有危险吗？
{{emote|*无视你*}}
我们别一起逗留。
愿食者（the Eaters）赐你恩物。
废料换货？
我也许愿意交易。
{{emote|*摇=pronouns.possessive=头*}}
{{emote|*把一根手指按在=pronouns.possessive=唇上*}}
我有武器。别乱来。
{{emote|*你一靠近就绷紧了*}}
找到什么好东西了吗？
谁捡到归谁。
下面好东西很多。坏东西也很多。
咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！
咿嘿。咿嘿嘿。咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！
你是食物？
给食物？
咬你？
嘎。咕噜。呼噜。哼。呼。
咧嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
啥！
咿嘿。嘿。啥。咿嘿嘿。啥！
咿咿咿嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。
活下去喝足水活下去喝足水活下去喝足水咿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
活去喝水。
活去和水。
活吞 得喝。
活姆 得喝。咿嘿嘿嘿。活噗 德隆！啊哈哈哈！

咯嘿嘿。
诶 诶嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！
{{emote|*盯着你，无声地流着口水*}}
咿咿咿嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻……
呃呵呵呵……
噜噜噜噜……
哼。
咿嘿嘿！咿嘿嘿嘿！啊哈哈哈！
呃，你为啥跟我说话？
咿嘿。
哈！
嘎哈哈！
啊哈哈哈！
哆呵呵呵呵呵。
哦 呵呵呵呵呵。
咯 嘿 嘿 嘿 嘿。
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
以太阳之名，你真丑。
挑个方向，然后往那儿走。
你想干什么，缺盐的？
跟缺盐的没什么好说的。
眼睛别停下，缺盐的。
嘿，缺盐的。你有多少水？不，这问题永远别答。
对红白旗放尊重点，我们就能相处。
把嘴捂上，不然卤气会把你的肺腌成肉干。
保持暖和，缺盐的。
保持干燥，缺盐的。
荣耀归于舍金纳。
我在我的父辈面前谦卑而行。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。对疲惫的朝圣者慈悲些。
愿尼兹洛克受赞美——祂庇护我们这些寻跷者。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。
来。看看我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=！
我看我的货抓住你的眼了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
你需要的东西我有，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感谢食者（the Eaters），你找到了卡德（Qud）唯一诚实的店主。
以我的名誉起誓，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有最高的品质，我做的买卖也公道。
欢迎，旅人。
欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今天我能为你效劳什么？
你的水袋是不是沉了，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
=player.FormalAddressTerm=，我恳求你。进来吧。
买点什么吧，行吗？
愿你寻得荫凉与吃食，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
快点。
以食者（the Eaters）之名，你见过这么多财宝吗？

start.text: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.
start.choice: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!
This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.
Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?
What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?

conversation.node: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.

Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.
Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.

Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.
The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.

Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.
Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.

Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.
Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

node.text: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.
node.choice: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?
Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.

node.text: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?

This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.

conversation.node: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.
=name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?

node.text: 赞美舍金纳，=name=，你那些黏液人朋友既勤快又好学！我忍不住有点担心他们这份勤勉，也担心教里谁会借此占便宜。若可能，我希望在他们被教成不好奇之前，先在他们心里养出读书的兴趣。也许办个读书会？
活着，学着，=name=。黏液人正像人们那样安顿下来。我看见有些面无表情地站在祭司与传道师两侧，可也有些证明了自己渴求知识。我已办起每周一次的颂歌研读小组，每次聚会人都在增多。为这次相聚赞美舍金纳，=name=。

Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.
node.choice: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

node.text: 你和我族人、以及好几位祭司一样悲观。我的心听懂了你的话，可也请听听我的话——也许你会渐渐与我有同感。贬低智慧，就是贬低卡萨菲斯肯斯（Kasaphescence）。她在虚空中照耀，折射光线，照亮周围的一切。我们先辈写下的智慧也是如此。铬的机巧在其神性上是繁复的。当我们对它、对我们的过去与未来一无所知时，岂不是亏待了我们的父辈？我们难道不配享有「知」的喜乐？愿埃舍尔斯塔特二世——第一位孩子——受福，因为他与我所信相同。
Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.
一位亲族的灵性主保，为我们做了那么多，也引领我和像我一样的人走上治愈之路。因为归根结底，他是一位医者。他为病人包扎伤口，把环流的瘟疫从这片土地上清除。他也曾是苏丹，但他是最后一位苏丹。是他拆掉了独治的砖墙，好让我们能在那些墙后藏着的果园里采浆果。
一座供奉盘曲之羔的寂静神龛，已有数百年。它藏在这里，在大理石胸墙之外，披着时间的尘土；那些对「尊雷谢夫过于别的父辈」嗤之以鼻的人，早已看不见它了。若你愿意，就进去念一段祷词吧。

text.text: 别深吸气，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我晾了些胶。
活下去，喝足水——但请到别处去喝。我怕洒。
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。请随意细看我这些书。
请只检查这些字的质量。我不是图书馆员。
这些书既耐盐蚀，也耐丛林。
我向你保证，胶一干，味儿就散了。
我有书可售，你若感兴趣。
我卖的每一样，都是许多小时辛劳的产物。
凑近些，让我看清你的脸。
我血管里流的就是墨水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
你若想读点什么，我这儿有你要的。
请对羊皮纸温柔些。
请快些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我还有很多活要干。
活下去，喝足水，读书人。
过来。不，再近点。别管那些蜂，它们很少蜇人。
别怕靠近。蜂很少蜇人。
要来点蜂汁吗？
每天早上喝一德拉姆（dram）蜂蜜，连斯洛格本人也弄不病你。
你知道吗，蜂靠跳舞交流。那是一整套语言。
没有蜂，卡德（Qud）的一切生命终将死去。
蜂比你以为的聪明。它们有那种群体心智，你懂吧。
我每天早上吃蜂蜜无酵饼，几十年没病过。
没有蜂，我们早就全死了，你知道的。
小玩意儿用得很狠，是吧？我能修。
你身上有什么，我都能修、能充、能鉴定！在合理的范围内。
你有什么弄不明白的东西，拿来就是。
对机器得有敬畏。机器咬起人来比任何鳄鱼都狠。
你也是做东西的？
把你弄坏的东西拿出来，我按公道价给你临时拼一台。
要废料吗？
跟火花和焊锡打上几年交道，那些划口和烫伤你就习惯了。
他们说有些人能跟机器说话。我说我们都能——只要听得对。
充电池的价钱，看你拿来的时候电池有多空。
废料绝对不退不换。
我希望不要中断这项工作太久。
我的关节多疼啊！买点什么吧，好让我这疼有个说法。
未完成的图纸显然不卖。别的都卖。
垃圾你要翻就翻，但绝对不许碰我的纸。
你是修补匠吗？我一定有你想造的东西。
你若有动手的头脑，我就有你想要的东西。
我为了这份投入失去了很多。帮我重新挣回来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
银之父作证，要是有人动过我纸张的顺序……
求你了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，买一张图纸吧。我相信它会对你有用。
即便你现在造不出某样东西，日后也可能用得着那份见识。
你有什么毛病，我这儿都有药。
你气色不太好。你饮食里得加点辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。
想买补剂吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？现在花水，还是以后流血，你自己挑。
棘礼和辟瘟麦（yuckwheat），出售。
不舒服就用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）做饭。病发现得够早，就能杀掉它。
你若是来吃那盘「低头派」的，最好没把任何猎心者引到这儿来。
「止痛，也乱脑。」嚼巫木树皮要当心。
霜菇别吃太快。
你的补剂够吗？
染上真菌了？那你得用我这儿一瓶喷雾，才上得了药。
想治疾病与真菌，得弄到一本《卡德（Qud）医典》。
你有什么毛病，我这儿都有药。
你气色不太好。你饮食里得加点辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）和蜂蜜。
不舒服就用辟瘟麦（yuckwheat）做饭。病发现得够早，就能杀掉它。
「止痛，也乱脑。」嚼巫木树皮要当心。
出镇之前最好带上些树皮和绷带，旅人。
活下去，喝足水。但愿你身体康健？
你今天感觉如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。身体还好吗？
我跟你说，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的配方是多年经验换来的。没有比得上的。
方圆数帕拉桑（parasang）最好的吃食！卡德（Qud）最好的吃食！配方与样品！
我愿意把我的食物秘诀分享给你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你愿意让我觉得值当。
你做饭吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种往锅里乱扔本地捡来的破烂的人，我就有货给你。
一句假话都没有：我师从一位厨师，而那位厨师师从玛瑙·断离之星本人。所以我的配方是最好的。
试试我的配方。你会觉得=player.reflexive=正在厨房七边形里评判那些碳化物厨师。
菜谱的名字最好从心里来。嘲笑菜谱之名的人，早已失了惊奇之心。
活下去，吃好饭，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
味儿有点冲？那正说明它是好东西。
几乎什么都能腌存。几……几乎。
腌过的食材做出来更好、更安全。
我卖的每一样，开袋即食都安全。
欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要干粮吗？
想要一点盐，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是要一整批盐？
没有什么比一堆篝火、火上却无物可炊更令人难过了。
你是厨子吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的干粮品质最高。
路上吃的，要吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
活下去，深深畅饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，请进。
我的货又甜又有劲，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想尝尝吗？
告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象比一顶没有酒的水烟帐更凄凉？
酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你还真正需要别的什么吗？
那位腌制作坊的和我都知道，最好的配料是时间。
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。来点玫瑰酒？一朵玫瑰是美，但你在高跷场混过就知道，五朵就是死。
液体……
它们不美吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？那些瓶子、那些小药管，光穿过它们的样子。
活下去，喝足水——但不是什么都喝。有些东西是不能喝的。
还有哪种形态比液体更精妙？
倾倒、滗出、收集、混合。我热爱我的志业。
只要它会流，我就想要它。你也该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
你有没有停下来想过流体？它们难道不是神圣的吗？
总有一天我要探到贝塞斯达·苏萨的深处，好去见那位炼金术士。
活下去，喝足水，然后收集，然后调配……
站住，贵族！我有能勾起你兴趣的货。
我这些植入体都是和平得来的，我向你保证。
你看起来多「体面」啊，贵族！不过你还能更体面些。
腿累了？胳膊？手？看看我这儿有什么合你的。
为有眼光的贵族准备的奢华内部饰件。
当然，无需额外消毒。
优质植入体，售价公道！
我看你就属于那种懂得手工器官价值的贵族。
我进的每一样我都推荐。当然，不是让你一次全装上。
希望你「体面」地再回来，哈哈。
活下去，喝足水，贵族。
杀过什么值钱的人吗？
你看着挺危险。去猎过零件吗？
有胆吗？＝有内脏吗？
你能想象把这种东西塞进自己身体里吗？恶心。
你要有植入体要卖，我水多的是。
记得常去「体面角」的架子上翻零件。
你没剖开过什么「儿子」或「女儿」吧？
我的货源打哪儿来，我知道得越少越好。
没洗干净的零件我也照收，没事。
你能宰一头野猪，就也能对人做同样的事。只不过你要找的不是肉。
我最好的主顾都不问问题。我最好的货源问得太多了。
活着，畅饮。
需要点什么来配齐你这一身吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
有一顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你在盐日下能撑得更久。
随便看看我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=。装点你的头——或者是几个头。
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要点新帽子吗？
你需要一顶新帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者一顶头盔——如果你过的是那种日子。
你若要从狒狒的地盘过，就该护住脑袋，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来给你的倦脚裹上点东西吧。
进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我带你「鞋」一圈，哈哈！
靴子！皮鞋！拖鞋！铁鞋！你想怎么裹你的脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
虽说我的产品品质这么高，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你去裂隙里走走试试它们。
有什么要问「一靴」的吗，=player.FormalAddressTerm=？就是个鞋匠的小笑话。
外头沙子烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋护住你了吗？
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=！要点鞋穿吗？
穿着我的鞋走上几帕拉桑（parasang），=player.formalAddressTerm=，你就会纳闷从前是怎么过的。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=。慢慢看我的货。
欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这破地方唯一的一处品味堡垒。
请把脚上的沙跺掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它到处钻。
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我当然能帮你。
我该如何为您着装，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
那么，=player.formalAddressTerm=，既然你来了这儿，我敢说你是有时尚眼光的。
哎呀。是谁给你穿的衣裳，=player.formalAddressTerm=？让我来帮帮你吧，求你了。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
{{emote|*无声地点头*}}
当心。烫。
=player.FormalAddressTerm=。要护具？
快点，行吗？
你好。
嗯？
我盯着你呢。
皮革、环甲、板甲，保你的命。
别靠近炉子。
=player.FormalAddressTerm=。活下去，喝足水。
手衣出售！免让你的指头蒙受提早离体的屈辱！
最好护住你的手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到被疯梭鱼咬掉一只，你才知道自己多需要它们。
轻手套、重手套、铁手甲。别让你的手光着，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
一个尺码全都能穿，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我卖给你，那就是合你的。
我的手怎么做得这么柔软？我永远不说。
快走了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的手套和手甲无需保养，做工就是这么精。
活下去，吃好饭，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
买我的铅弹枪不会错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
枪，枪，枪！它们不让你笑吗？
=player.FormalAddressTerm=，我跟你说：最好的防守，就是一场出色的、远距离的进攻。
啊，我爱线状火药的味道。你知道的，那股硫磺味？要我说，助燃剂就是上好的香水。
你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，曾有个从「呵欠月」来的旅人跟我说，我这店闻着像家。现在我倒想去看看了！哈！
愿你找到足够的掩体，以及多到搬不动的战利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我从前也像你一样是个旅人，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但旧伤会让你慢下来。趁有时间，珍惜它。
我真希望能在店里让你试试我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但你往任何方向走一帕拉桑（parasang），都能找到靶子。
工作台上的东西，最好别碰，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
活下去、喝足水、开枪吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，顺序随你。
有什么要炸的吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
手雷躺在背包里毫无用处。别忘了用。
=player.FormalAddressTerm=，没有多少事是一枚投得好的手雷解决不了的……只要你别站太近。
落叶剂和杀真菌剂完全安全，不过你还是别深呼吸为好。
要来点爆炸性的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
你还会回来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=——只要你别把=player.reflexive=炸了。
你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。翻看我的货时请当心。
你的投掷臂力如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？若是不行，你觉得自己运气好吗？
这活儿危险，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但很值得。
酒农们说「一朵玫瑰是美，五朵就是死」。我这儿的花，不论几朵都意味着死。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
每一块石头里都藏着一个形状，等着被取出来。
把光折到那个角度，它就散成一片璀璨。
为了雕出下一尊小像的灵感，我可以等上几年。我以前就等过。
我们的眼睛是怎样一种宝石，竟能把光扭成思想？
进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，欣赏我的宝石与小像。
未加工的宝石与金属买卖同价，但我这件艺术品的价签由我定。
每一尊小雕像都算是一种献礼，但并非每一份献礼都被欣然接受。
这些拿来作水仪式上的谈资，岂不正好？
漂亮的小饰物和闪亮的宝石，这边看！
一颗打磨精良、挑选得当的宝石，无论多粗陋，都和小雕像一样是美丽的艺术品。
凑近些看细节。不，别碰。
我的宝石里烧着的火，比某些人心里的还亮。
水财富若带不走就毫无意义。要珠宝吗？
朋友，我有贵金属与珠宝，可供装点或交易。
未加工的金属与宝石买卖同价，以水计价。
来吧，游荡者，把那些沉甸甸的水换成一兜财富。
水老板毕竟不会拿水来装点自己。

start.text: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...

node.text: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.
{{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...
{{emote|*喃喃自语*}} ……与克兰克常数出现了意外偏差。{{emote|*阿盖夫咳嗽。*}} 你非得来打扰我吗？你算什么，某种水怪？长着幼鹿眼睛的朝圣者？秘术航行者？那就让=player.reflexive=有点用处，去某个洞穴里给我捡个小玩意回来。我或许会「奖赏」你。
node.choice: Where can I find a cave?

node.text: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...
node.choice: I will return with your knickknack.

start.text: You're standing in my light! What do you want?

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Fetch Argyve a Knickknack~Return to Argyve

start.choice: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.

start.text: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!
Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Fetch Argyve Another Knickknack~Return to Argyve

node.text: {{emote|*阿盖夫吹了声口哨。*}} 厉害啊你！也许你够格在我的工坊里翻翻，跟我换点废料。我一直想再收个学徒。斯克雷夫真是可惜——毕竟被剖了膛那档子事。坐吧，就那儿。
{{emote|*阿盖夫双眉一挑。*}} 那么，把螺帽拧上螺栓——也就是给你个解释！你看，我正处在突破的边缘。一项伟大的发现。异线导管快装好了；一旦装成，我们就能跟任何人……瞬时交谈！从这儿直到伊德自由邦。但在完工之前，我需要线材。你能找到多少就要多少……至少两百尺。你该能从锈井里捡到。

start.text: The wire! Give it to me!

choice.IfFinishedQuestStep: Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!~Find 200 Feet of Wire

node.text: {{emote|*阿盖夫欢呼*}} 对，对！漂亮的线材！——哦，趁我还没忘，我给你修好了一台旧返回器。你想快速跳回约帕（Joppa）时就用它。现在，给我几分钟接上线……

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Weirdwire Conduit... Eureka!~Return to Argyve

start.text: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...

node.text: It's repeating itself...
{{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?
node.choice: Can I know what it is?

node.text: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.
node.choice: I require no further information. I will go.

node.text: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.
好极了！完美！让我把信号录到数据盘上——恐怕你得用命守着它。我再给你搭一个机器人干扰器。你看，巴拉瑟鲁姆派编了一队寻路机器人守卫通往砂砾门的道路。有了干扰器，你就不必担心它们。在那儿等着。
{{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}
Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!

start.text: {{emote|*阿盖夫简短地点了下头，又高挑了一下眉毛。*}} 学徒。{{emote|*阿盖夫回到他的活计上。*}}
start.choice: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.
Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.

start.text: My apprentice! What?

node.text: 是吗？对对，奥索也许会。嗯。{{emote|*阿盖夫停顿了长得令人不适的一段时间。*}} 好吧。{{emote|*又是一段停顿，比上一段更长、更令人不适*}} 祝你好运！
真的吗？可你不是我的=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！砂砾门不是约帕（Joppa），你这自大的焊钉；在这间屋子里你依旧是个学徒。那么，你想要什么？快说！
——什么？不，不，我太专心了，没空应付你的好奇心。我确信巴拉瑟鲁姆派有活儿给你干。
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的相见方式致歉，但我们必须谨慎行事。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。你竟能带着如此浅薄的阅历从各各他（Golgotha）归来，足见前途无量。收下这把火器作为报酬。它带着我们最好的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。这只手镯也一并收下。等你准备好谈那道信号时再来。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: More Than a Willing Spirit~Return to Grit Gate|3000

node.text: 欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的相见方式致歉，但我们必须谨慎行事。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。见你带着寻路机器人回来，我很欣慰——尽管你对所背负的危险仍所知甚少。收下这把火器作为报酬。它带着我们最好的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。等你准备好谈那道信号时再来。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: More Than a Willing Spirit~Return to Grit Gate|1250

node.text: 欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉瑟鲁姆的管家。为我们的相见方式致歉，但我们必须谨慎行事。卡德（Qud）是个极不留情的地方。你有资格与我们同修。收下这些。等你准备好谈那道信号时再来。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: More Than a Willing Spirit~Return to Grit Gate|750

node.text: 要在这里获得信任，光有热心还不够，行路者。证明你的价值，给我们带一台寻路机器人来，那时我们才有更多可谈的。
Are you ready to discuss the signal?

那道信号是一段从不明来源播出的重复传输。=V0tinkeraddendum=我们的修补匠之一，{{m|Q女郎}}，在架设长波探测器时发现了它。遗憾的是，它经过加密，而我们此地没有解密的手段。不过这这件事上，你或许能帮上忙。我们早就知道，在{{C|贝塞斯达·苏萨}}大礼堂的深处有一台运转完好的{{W|贝提尔}}。机械教派已将它四周的地面奉为圣地，并在那里建起一座神庙。Q女郎声称已找到解密那道信号的方法，但她需要那台贝提尔的计算能力。若你能潜入机械教派的营地，或许就能与那台贝提尔交感，解出那道信号。
它们是古老的石头，位于卡德（Qud）洞穴深处某些特定的地方。我们相信它们是食者（the Eaters）建造的某种超高级机械。它们常被声称具有自己的知觉。然而，自被造出以来的漫长岁月里，它们大多已经失常；要找到一台电路完全未受侵蚀的，实属罕见。机械教派把这一台当作神像崇拜，并会不惜一切代价保护它。你必须设法穿过他们的信众，抵达那台贝提尔本身。你觉得你能办到吗？
node.choice: I must think on this task.

node.text: 很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找{{m|Q女郎}}。她会把给贝提尔的指令编码到数据盘的副本上。还有一件事。那台贝提尔位于食者（the Eaters）古老低温舱区的下方。岁月已侵蚀了封存其低温雾气的机件。那寒雾如今自舱室中自由涌出，冷却着整座洞穴。你最好弄些保暖衣物来护住=player.reflexive=。机械教派的战利品归你所有。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉瑟鲁姆会善待你的效力。
node.choice: I will return with the data, Steward.

node.text: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
node.choice: I will return with the data, Steward.

node.text: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?
Well done, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Present the disk.

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Decoding the Signal~Return to Grit Gate|6000

node.text: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.
=name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?

巴拉瑟鲁姆需要你去办一件极其重要的事。你必须远赴北方的{{C|奥蒙波奇}}。纺锤（the Spindle）从大地直抵天空。遗憾的是，一位来自植物财团（Consortium of Phyta）的麻烦商人迁到了那里，并自封为奥蒙波奇伯爵。我们需要你去谈成一笔交易，好让我们租得纺锤的控制权。若谈不成，你就得除掉这位自封的伯爵。接近奥蒙波奇时要当心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在卡德（Qud）如此靠东的地界，普图斯圣殿骑士正伺机而动。
node.choice: What is the purpose of this?
I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.
I must think on this task.

node.text: 普图斯圣殿骑士——他们自称「子与女」——是一个骑士团，自称是食者（the Eaters）的后裔。食者是营造卡德（Qud）铬色厅堂的古代族群。要当心他们：他们憎恶一切变异者，而对巴拉瑟鲁姆怀有格外的恶意。小心别让=player.reflexive=落进他们的奴隶栏里。
node.choice: What is the purpose of this?
I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.
I must think on this task.

node.text: 到时候自会告知你。别忘了自己的位置，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。
node.choice: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.
I must think on this task.

node.text: 正如我所担心的，=name=。砂砾门正遭进攻。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是跟着你从奥蒙波奇回来的。趁他们抵达前的这点宝贵时间，我们赶紧布置防御。
Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!
用我给你的铬合金钥匙卡，你现在可以进入我们的电网。整个飞地内布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。用埃列什基伽勒的侦察情报来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以与埃列什基伽勒交感，以广播超频指令或启动罗达尼斯·Y。但要留意电流负荷。若电网过载，你会造成电压不足。快行动，=name=！圣殿骑士在我们说话的工夫里已经逼近了。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Grave Thoughts~Speak to Otho

node.choice: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

node.text: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...
沉重的念头，=name=。现在听我说。拿上这张钥匙卡，去埃列什基伽勒的房间，然后——哦，那是指主机。她喜欢别人这么称呼它。去她的房间，接入埃列什基伽勒，扫描飞地周围的页岩以寻找异常。我已让她备好传感器。把你查到的告诉我。你可以用埃列什基伽勒房间东北角的对讲机来传报。快去！我巴不得自己的恐惧被证明是多余的。
你仍然可以启动我们的防御，=name=。整个飞地内布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。用埃列什基伽勒的侦察情报来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以与埃列什基伽勒交感，以广播超频指令或启动罗达尼斯·Y。但要留意电流负荷。若电网过载，你会造成电压不足。
node.choice: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

node.text: Have you secured the Spindle yet?

node.text: Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.

node.text: 此外，我与巴拉瑟鲁姆谈过。他称赞你处理奥蒙波奇伯爵的方式，并感谢你在守卫砂砾门时表现出的勇气。今天的袭击提醒我们：我们太久以来都寄望于本团的孤立与普图斯圣殿骑士的牵绊。又一次袭击的迫近威胁促使巴拉瑟鲁姆加快他的计划，连带提升你在本团中的地位。你被擢升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟鲁姆希望立刻与你谈谈。
node.choice: 他想跟我说话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？

node.text: 我与巴拉瑟鲁姆谈过。他称赞你处理奥蒙波奇伯爵的方式，并感谢你在守卫砂砾门时表现出的勇气。今天的袭击提醒我们：我们太久以来都寄望于本团的孤立与普图斯圣殿骑士的牵绊。又一次袭击的迫近威胁促使巴拉瑟鲁姆加快他的计划，连带提升你在本团中的地位。你被擢升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟鲁姆希望立刻与你谈谈。
node.choice: 他想跟我说话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？
他想跟我说话？巴拉瑟鲁姆本人？

node.text: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.
I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！我向你致以最深的谢意。少有=player.personTerm|pluralize=能如此干练地守住砂砾门。现在，请给我时间评估损失、与巴拉瑟鲁姆商议。早点回来。
Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.
node.choice: Thank you for the update, Otho.

node.text: Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.
node.choice: Thank you for the update, Otho.

node.text: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.
node.choice: Thank you for the update, Otho.

node.text: Yes, =name=?

conversation.node: Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.

node.text: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.

conversation.node: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.
Has this slynth situation been settled yet?

node.text: 我没想到自己会承认这一点，门徒，但那些难民确实达到了我的期望。和你一样，他们在劳作与求知上都表现出不止一份热心。黏液人有前途，你把他们带来也许是对的。
活着，畅饮，门徒。你会乐于知道，黏液人已证明自己配得上学徒身份。只要他们恪守并服侍本团的信条，就可以在此居住。
正如我所担心的，=name=。砂砾门正遭进攻。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是跟着你从奥蒙波奇回来的。趁他们抵达前的这点宝贵时间，我们赶紧布置防御。
用我给你的铬合金钥匙卡，你现在可以进入我们的电网。整个飞地内布有链式激光炮位与力场投射器。用埃列什基伽勒的侦察情报来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以与埃列什基伽勒交感，以广播超频指令或启动罗达尼斯·Y。但要留意电流负荷。若电网过载，你会造成电压不足。快行动，=name=！圣殿骑士在我们说话的工夫里已经逼近了。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Grave Thoughts~Speak to Otho

node.choice: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

node.text: {{emote|*loud static*}}
Quetzal! Who are you, stranger?
It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?
Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

choice.IfNotFinishedQuestStep: Pax Klanq, I Presume?~Get Q Girl's Blueprints for the Climber

node.choice: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.
Did you feel that rumbling, Q女郎?
Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.
There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?

choice.IfNotFinishedQuestStep: Decoding the Signal~Get Q Girl's Instructions onto the Data Disk

node.choice: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?

node.text: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?

It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.
Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?
Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!
哦，哦！绿咬鹃！一个给短波探测器用的缩波器、一个给离子车床用的锥台滑轮、一条三重反螺纹的 M 频带，还有……{{emote|*她继续说着。*}}……以及一篇论权力之不正当性的论文。绿咬鹃！
I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Decoding the Signal~Get Q Girl's Instructions onto the Data Disk

node.text: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Pax Klanq, I Presume?~Get Q Girl's Blueprints for the Climber

start.text: Should you be here, =player.offspringTerm=?

start.IfFinishedQuestStep: Tomb of the Eaters~Disable the Spindle's Magnetic Field
start.text: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.

node.text: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.
node.choice: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.
I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.
Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?

node.text: {{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆顿了顿。*}} 是的。出于我稍后会说明的理由——超出我们任何一方职权范围的理由——克兰克回到了砂砾门。
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆顿了顿。*}} 异常的境况使我的书房一片凌乱。可叹，此事确然，然亦必要。
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆顿了顿。*}} 我确信你此言之中蕴藏着丰厚的智慧。他日我必将乐于探寻。眼下——纺锤（the Spindle）如何？
{{emote|*巴拉瑟鲁姆深深舒了一口气。*}} 你向来是喜讯的信使，=name=。我乐见此事。在这历史性的时刻，类别与类型正逐渐崩解。尽管如此，仪式仍滋养着我们。你被擢升为门生，=name=——那个懂得的人。
Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.
Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?

High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q女郎的 climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...

This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q女郎 and I now work in assistance to the project...
A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.
帕克斯·克兰克将以原始生物电材料塑成那造物。你必须收集这些「内脏」：作为模体的躯壳、为血之流质充能的催化剂、作为神性指向的超验印记（atzmus）、用于防护的武装，以及赋予人格的五手护符（hamsa）。你还将与那造物联结，充任它的驾驶者——为此你必须念诵咒文，把这份联结铭刻下来。此外你还需要取得血之流质本身，以及一个能屏蔽电磁攻击的动力源。
node.choice: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?
I'm to pilot the creature? And bond with it?
I need time and space from this.
I wish to ask about something else.

node.text: 它们是我们将要培育、塑形并焊入那「升华之体」的组件。待你开始之后，我们可以细究其中关节；届时帕克斯·克兰克亦可作为知识的来源。每取得一件组件，就把它带到克兰克旁边那堆废料与黏土处。
它们就是那些组件——我们将要培育、塑形、并焊进那上升之存在里的。细节去问帕克斯·克兰克。你每取得一件组件，就把它带到克兰克旁边那堆废铁与黏土垒起的土丘去。
正确。那造物会被塑得足够宽阔以容纳两人，但唯有你会与之联结。唯有你能驾驶。不过，不必担心被无法脱开的系带困住。那造物在无人驾驶时也能行动，只是反应较慢。
Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.

是的，动力一事更为棘手。我们标准的电源或许够用，但在上升途中它们易受电磁攻击，而我们相信普图斯圣殿骑士有能力发动这样的攻击。于是我们只剩两条路。克兰克与Q女郎已设计出一种中子电池，在电磁频谱上全无破绽——但它需要 3 德拉姆（dram）中子流（neutron flux）。另一条路是远程供能，可要载我们横越纺锤（the Spindle）的全长，那源头必须非凡。我会向查瓦——生命之树——求取一份灵能上的「激启」。有报告说他们已恢复在月梯上的游荡。若你选这条路，就去艾恩罗吉寻那树干，从那里开始调查。
是的，=name=！开始收集吧，塑形随后便来。你所选的材料会影响我们造出的存在，但任何这样的存在都足以完成上升。这是我们历史性攀登之前的最后一件差事，=name=。做它的时候，务必平安顺遂。若你还有疑问，就回到这里。克兰克与我都在。
The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.
如今，我们在奥蒙波奇的操作员已确认：与圣殿骑士的冲突不可避免。这是严酷的事实，但它确实为你们的羁绊留出了绽放的余地。去吧，去熟悉引领与驾驶你的造物。等你准备好就回来，我们终将向星辰而去。
node.choice: I will, Barathrum. Live and drink.

node.text: Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Our fates are not reversible past the next event horizon.
We go. I-

O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?
我……无妨。意志亦能击碎命轮。我们走。但愿上升途中的减重对我有益。听说越过世界的壳之后，人的重负便再也拉扯不动了。
Klanq is able to answer your questions. You received an operating manual, too, no? Perhaps you could reference it.

start.text: Come closer, nestling. Let me look upon your countenance.
start.choice: Otho said you wished to speak with me.
What's with the houseplant over there?
Please tell me about the signal again.
Please tell me about the signal again.

choice.IfFinishedQuestStep: Pax Klanq, I Presume?~Convince Pax Klanq to Construct the Climber

start.choice: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.
Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?
Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?
The magnetic field has been disabled and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?
Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.
The creature has been made. What now?
Tell me again how the giant creature functions.
I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.

node.text: What can I offer, nestling?
You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Tomb of the Eaters~Return to Grit Gate

node.text: What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Pax Klanq, I Presume?~Return to Grit Gate

node.text: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?
node.choice: I need time on my own first.

node.text: 攀爬机的设计依靠电磁体与行星磁场相互作用以产生扭矩。遗憾的是，纺锤（the Spindle）自身会产生干扰场——或许是一种阻止不请自来者上升的机制。我们的目标是接入纺锤的控制单元并关闭该场。然而如何做到，仍是一桩谜。埃列什基伽勒从数字典藏的零散残片中，织出了一幅隐晦却可作指引的锦图。她查明：该场可以在一个名为明暗界（Brightsheol）的地方关闭；那地方位于薄世（the Thin World）之中，只能经由食者（the Eaters）之墓里雷谢夫的陵寝进入。

古怪，此事，且不精确——但身为修补匠，我们明白：粗陋的图纸也胜过没有图纸。你必须回到奥蒙波奇，进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。进去之后，循着盗墓者与破坏者在陵中劈出的那些岔路，登上雷谢夫的墓室。至于如何进入此墓：雷谢夫在一千年前封了大门，但那封印有一处破绽。古老的「死亡之印」已湮没于岁月，可若你能寻回它，并把此印刻在自己身上，死亡之门便会为你开启——正如在早已模糊的往昔，它为无数食者的尸身开启那样。寻回死亡之印吧，=name=，进入此墓，越入明暗界（Brightsheol）。把你的爪子再一次放上那罗盘与鼓面。
node.choice: I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.
You ask so much. I must consider it.

node.text: As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
node.choice: 我记住了你的警告。别了，巴拉瑟鲁姆。

node.text: 攀爬机的设计依靠电磁体与行星磁场相互作用以产生扭矩。遗憾的是，纺锤（the Spindle）自身会产生干扰场——或许是一种阻止不请自来者上升的机制。我们的目标是接入纺锤的控制单元并关闭该场。然而如何做到，仍是一桩谜。埃列什基伽勒从数字典藏的零散残片中，织出了一幅隐晦却可作指引的锦图。她查明：该场可以在一个名为明暗界（Brightsheol）的地方关闭；那地方位于薄世（the Thin World）之中，只能经由食者（the Eaters）之墓里雷谢夫的陵寝进入。

古怪，此事，且不精确——但身为修补匠，我们明白：粗陋的图纸也胜过没有图纸。你必须回到奥蒙波奇，进入食者（the Eaters）之墓。进去之后，循着盗墓者与破坏者在陵中劈出的那些岔路，登上雷谢夫的墓室。至于如何进入此墓：雷谢夫在一千年前封了大门，但那封印有一处破绽。古老的「死亡之印」已湮没于岁月，可若你能寻回它，并把此印刻在自己身上，死亡之门便会为你开启——正如在早已模糊的往昔，它为无数食者的尸身开启那样。你要寻回死亡之印，=name=，进入此墓，越入明暗界（Brightsheol）。

Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.
node.choice: I have more to ask, Barathrum.

node.text: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.
node.choice: And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?

node.text: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.

That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.

我记得。你对本团的效力值得称许，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你闯过贝塞斯达·苏萨的雾汽深渊、解出了那道信号，你守住了纺锤（the Spindle）场、处置了那位自封的伯爵，而或许最要紧的是——你从普图斯圣殿骑士手中守住了我们的飞地。自你从贝塞斯达归来，你无疑一直对那信号的 contents 心存疑惑。说实话，我把它藏了起来，以免你背负真相之重。此前只有奥索、Q女郎和我担着这份重担，但情势已变。时间之河驱动着我们谋划与器物的齿轮组，而它奔涌向前。从此刻起，我必须分担这份重担。你必须知道。
node.choice: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?

node.text: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.
node.choice: And what is the Spindle, truly?

node.text: 那座信标证实了我的假设。纺锤（the Spindle）是一部升降机，由食者（the Eaters）建造，用于往返于天穹之库运送货物。你看，雏儿，在我们过往最初的曙光里，大地上的食者曾与一个横跨苍穹的庞大女巫会相结交。但食者屈从于某种可怕的诱惑，于是我们这个世界被下了一道禁令。自那以后，星辰对我们沉默，我们的世界任其腐朽衰败。可有些事变了。那道信号确认：有一存在栖息于纺锤之顶，并邀请我们前去与它会合。我敢说——禁令是否已到尽头？现在断言尚早，但天可怜见，我们的世界或许还有希望。
node.choice: I have more to ask, Barathrum.

node.text: 我打算登上纺锤（the Spindle），回应那呼唤，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我的门生{{m|Q女郎}}为这次上升设计了一台攀爬机。我们本想分件在飞地与现场建造，但这项工程之艰，连我们也力有不及。若有时间，我确信我们能成，可普图斯圣殿骑士夺走了我们的从容。我们必须即刻行动——因此，尽管我不愿承认，我们需要帕克斯·克兰克。
帕克斯·克兰克是一位古怪的蘑菇天才。撇开其种种毛病不谈，他们是杰出的科学家与工程师，我毫不怀疑他们能比我们更快地造成攀爬机。我们上次联络已是数年前，但他们欠我们一笔债，如今我们须去收回。遗憾的是，无人知道帕克斯·克兰克的下落。我通过多年积累的人脉打听其行踪，所能得到的最多只是这样一段谜般的指示：「寻彩虹之心，食神之肉，循珊瑚之路。」
我必须请你去解开这桩谜题、找到帕克斯·克兰克，并说服他们建造攀爬机。提醒帕克斯他们欠我们的债。在我看来，这道「彩虹」很可能指的是彩虹林——克兰克的亲族聚在那里，所以我建议你从那里着手。
node.choice: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q女郎的 design.
I must weigh everything you've told me.

node.text: 正如我所期望的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。首先去与Q女郎谈。她会把设计交给你。我等你回来。

Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.
You are a bear of few words.
Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?

node.text: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}

node.text: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}

{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱示意你等一下，然后在=pronouns.possessive=工作台上散落的纸张与碎料间翻找了一分来钟。最后=pronouns.subjective=取出一幅圆柱体的石墨速写，画中的高光处理得极精，显出它的表面亮如玻璃。柱中之物模糊幽暗，却不知为何透着威胁。*}} {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱指了指那层玻璃，做了个击破的手势，又用拇指在=pronouns.possessive=喉上横划一下。*}}

node.choice: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?
You are happy because you are with your family?
If I might change the subject...

node.choice: Let us speak of other things.

{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱两只手各比出一个「L」形，拇指朝下、手指相对，随后把双手一翻，让=pronouns.possessive=拇指朝上。接着=pronouns.subjective=把握拳的手举到=pronouns.possessive=嘴边，伸出拇指，做出仰饮的样子。*}} {{emote|*做完这些，=pronouns.subjective=又点了一次头，转回=pronouns.possessive=活计。*}}

Is this it, I wonder?

start.text: 我看你回来了。想必明暗界（Brightsheol）也没那么有趣？又或者，你是想我了。{{emote|*伊塞帕眨了眨眼*}}
start.choice: What do you think of Klanq's visit?
Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.

node.text: 我不知道。克兰克的晦涩既迷人、又令人气恼，而且危险。和克兰克一样，我对克兰克的看法也难以简单说明。你们共同造出的东西会很惊人。好好打造。
node.choice: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

start.text: 这是这个故事的最后几章，=name=，很可能也是许多故事的。无论如何，能见到这一切的另一面总是好的。
start.choice: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

node.text: 你要去薄世？我承认有几分羡慕。我多次梦见自己消融进一片清凉的信息之海，把肉身的外壳从新得自由的羽管上抖落。若那是醒着的生活所致，那我届时会不会梦见在斗室里干杂活的伊塞帕？也许我最好别知道。
node.choice: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.

start.text: 啊，是我们新来的短指朋友。坐一阵吧，如果你喜欢坐着的话。{{emote|*伊塞帕打了个哈欠*}}或者喜欢咒语，或者喜欢伊塞帕。如果你喜欢伊塞帕，这里是个非常好的地方。
start.choice: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?
Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
What are you working on, Iseppa?
I wish to know more about you.

node.text: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.
node.choice: What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

node.text: 贝塞斯达·苏萨是个对跖之地，一座生与死、以及两者之间各阶段的陈列馆。它的深处延展生命，也早早终结生命；把生命从日子的流中抽走，或把它送回。它会设法让你迟到。你要小心按时回来。
虽然我喜爱奥蒙波奇的景致与气味，但那里的虫子实在扰人。若我要去那儿，总会带上些它们没法一窜就躲开的东西。
是的。那不是洞穴的声音。感觉像我的一个噩梦终于活了过来。
我没有。不过我很想见见他。他像是个有趣的菌子。但我不敢去。我怕那些淤泥。
我怕淤泥——那种你已经不能用「一些」来形容的淤泥。它们由存在本身的古老质料所生，满怀恶意，只想吃下一切能吃的，而它们什么都能吃。它们喝起来时更糟。对它们要当心。
我总是很累，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我的睡眠时断时续，而且总有骇人的幻象。有时我的休息还得靠药来哄。
node.choice: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?

node.text: 不。我的噩梦只是我紊乱心神的产物，仅此而已。这口坩埚的烟气与未来无关——除了它如何影响未来。{{emote|*伊塞帕叹口气。*}}我倒想说点别的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
嗯——嗯。{{emote|*伊塞帕打了个哈欠。*}}
我绝不会夺走你自行评价我这飞地的乐趣。{{emote|*伊塞帕打了个哈欠。*}}况且，那听起来要讲很多话。
我是伊塞帕，而她就是我。我想过要做成另一个人，但从没想得够久到去试。

text.text: 我在琢磨动物与石头的分别。它们为何不同？一个动物不再算动物时，得像石头到什么地步？
我在思量我们各自借以观看宇宙的那扇意识之窗。我们死时，它会怎样？
我在清点自己的各项官能，找找有没有从前没数进去的。
我在把「念头」当作一个独立的对象来考察。我想弄清自己能否只想一个念头，以及如何把它与同类的另一个念头区分开。
我在考察一物之善恶如何判定，以及由谁判定。数据与主观评价之间的相互作用，还有那些指引我们、却说不出口的价值。
我在冥想纺锤（the Spindle）在卡德（Qud）的位置，它作为概念焦点的地位。我们所知的纺锤，有多少是前人营造、一路带过来的？
我在考察叙事的遗产。那些在我们心智还像油灰时讲给我们听的故事，那些塑造了我们是谁、也塑造了整个卡德（Qud）的痴愚。

node.choice: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.
Have you come to any conclusions?
I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.

node.text: Yes.
node.choice: But you're also doing the other thing.

node.text: Not yet, but that's not the point.
node.choice: I'll leave you to it, then.

node.text: Who are you? Get out of my work space!
Innovation's sworn enemies have come knocking, =name=. Let us answer them.

node.text: 奥索禁止我索取一份克兰克样本。要我忍住不被喷，自己去培养！我们还是研究者吗？受试者同意难道不再是足够的伦理严谨？让克兰克来喷达尔迪吧！
node.choice: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

start.text: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.
start.choice: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

node.text: Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.

start.text: {{emote|*达尔迪从=pronouns.possessive=众多工作台上抬起头也没抬，那些台子多半冒着烟、蒸汽或某种不明瘴气。*}} 欢迎来到我的实验室，=name=。歇一歇，养养=player.reflexive=，再继续你的旅程。
start.choice: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
Did you feel that rumbling, Dardi?
Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
That smell from the oven is... indescribable.
Laboratory? You work in a kitchen.

node.text: 是的！我从前闯过它的码头，为我的实验采集珍贵的「康复精」。你要去吗？穿暖些，当心那些巨魔。
node.choice: Did you call this kitchen your laboratory?

node.text: 奥蒙波奇是上好的芭蕉产地，但对自封的贵族我没什么好说的。自称的权威香气冲鼻，底下却没有汤。我们只管安抚阿斯福德尔，让伊去沉溺伊的幻想吧。
我那个充气酥点的实验被那阵骚动毁了。不管是谁干的，都要付出高昂代价。
我只去过彩虹林一次，在那里尝了一连串奇怪的食物，其中一种给了我一副异样的镜片来看世界。那是我从未有过的体验，我还想象出诸多奇妙的食谱。当然，我尽力把它们全记了下来。可惜一回到我平常的参照系，那些字迹就变得无法辨读了。世事如此。
你闻到的是砂砾门的招牌菜。那碗粥是巴拉瑟鲁姆派世代相传的食谱，也正是它促使我投身此道。是的，外人对那气味的浓烈望而却步——因为它的味道与它的效力一样霸道！我们用烹饪从体内引出雷电！别的食谱还能让我们喷火，或知晓食者（the Eaters）的秘密。那碗粥与巴拉瑟鲁姆之钟、沫沫机一样，是我们传承中同样珍贵的一部分。
哦，它每小时都在变，有时每分钟。腌这个、观察那个，什么都加，什么都尝。可我最中意的那颗星苹果、我投以雄心目光的那根纺锤（the Spindle）……是可食的蒸汽。你能吃、也能呼吸的食物。可惜至今我做到的最多只是一份加了香草的盐水悬浮液。咸味的空气，你若愿意这么说。
node.choice: Good luck with your experiments, then.

node.text: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.
node.choice: I will leave you to it. Live and drink.

node.text: 我不需要运气，但仍感谢你的好意。愿你自己的事业也如我的事业般驱动着你。你还想说别的吗？
Kitchen? You think this a mere kitchen?
node.choice: It certainly looks like a kitchen.
No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.
Why don't I see myself out?

node.text: 那么我猜高跷不过是一座不起眼的小教堂，它的大集市也不过是旧货摊？看看你四周。你见到的每一件仪器都经过精密校准，每一件工具都手工打造、经久耐用。在这间屋里，食物与巧思交汇，推动烹饪本身演化——不只塑造这一种文化，而是随时间塑造每一种文化。那种影响是厨房的产物吗？花田里一只简陋的陶炉能做到我们这里做的事吗？每一间厨房都对卡德（Qud）有不可磨灭的影响吗？{{emote|*他皱眉。*}} 该有吗？我们所有人不该都有吗？
可也许你是对的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想一想。集体知识这锅汤里的每一种配料都宝贵，我又凭什么把自己抬到更卑微的先驱之上？但是！这更说明我们该把烹饪（进而把文化本身）视为一项科学事业——持续不断的试错，已知与未知的调和，请现实本身来做我们的向导。你比我以为的更有洞见，=name=。谢谢你这一番讨论。你还需要别的吗？
I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.
Not like this. After all we've accomplished...

start.IfFinishedQuestStep: Tomb of the Eaters~Disable the Spindle's Magnetic Field
start.text: Ah. It's you again, returning from ever more unreturnable locales. Alive and come to bother the disagreeable urshiib.
start.choice: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

node.text: 我没想到我的人生还能再被掀翻一次。说真的，我学到了很多，而我恨透了这一切。等你们这些家伙到了纺锤（the Spindle）之巅，也许能劝你们就待在那儿？又或者，我可以代你们去。
node.choice: We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.

start.text: 我花了那么久为「家可能被攻破」这一可能做准备。我并没有准备好。这种被侵犯的感觉，像电烙一样灼烧。
start.choice: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

node.text: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.

start.text: 你来找我说话当然只是时间问题。我大概没法说服你让我安静地做我的事吧？我对行路者而言毫无有趣之处。我的每一天都大同小异：我维护并保护我的孩子们，这就够了。若我想交谈，还有埃列什基伽勒。
start.choice: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?
Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: 贝塞斯达·苏萨是个生机勃勃、繁荣的生态系统，其中没有我们的位置。话虽如此，若有人去清掉那里泛滥的机械教派，我绝不会抱怨。你若去那儿，注意脚下。潜伏的「贝斯」的叶状体，能把我们这种有肉的生灵迅速放干血。
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: 我知道奥蒙波奇是个难受又炎热的地方，而阿斯福德尔是个自命不凡的粗人。我连芭蕉都不喜欢。
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: 我见过帕克斯·克兰克。我被喷过。坦白说，我更喜欢能吃的、不活动的菌类。
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: My chromelings, my machines, my crops. I tend to them and they tend to me.
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: 与别的有机体交谈，对我而言和任何体力运动一样费力。我的隐居并非出于厌恶；我只是没法像你那样轻松地交谈，也不想去学。
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: 埃列什基伽勒是砂砾门的主机。用她的话说，她透过薄世守望，而我们维护她在厚世中的存在。我觉得她与我彼此理解。
node.choice: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

node.text: =player.OffspringTerm=, who are you?
Stay safe, =name=. Please.

start.IfFinishedQuestStep: Tomb of the Eaters~Disable the Spindle's Magnetic Field
start.text: =name=，你回来了！我还担心我们会把你丢在那陵墓里，可你看上去好得不能再好。也许我该更有信心些，至少少担些心。顺便问一句，你去过巴拉瑟鲁姆的工坊了吗？克兰克和Q女郎在那儿等你。

node.text: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.

I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.
node.choice: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.

start.text: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.
start.choice: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.
Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.

node.text: ……我不喜欢这事。我知道你会去。挖的时候请当心；莫潘戈的游荡者说，那地方的脏腑里还流着食者（the Eaters）机巧的热血。

start.text: Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?

Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

node.text: 那里有康复精的池子。你看，低温雾气凝结时会形成一种清凉、发亮的液体，若能泡在里面便有益于康复。哦！还有，在其中一座废弃的病房里，「炼金术士」开着他的铺子。你问炼金术士是谁？一个有点神秘的人物——业余的液体修补匠、诗人、商人。他的方法算不上科学，但如果你在找某种特定的液体，他很有用。只是在他身边要小心，=name=。

node.text: {{emote|*霍尔滕莎轻声笑。*}} 你很敏锐，=name=。某种意义上，我就是干这个的。可液体比废料更任性。我没法把它们焊在一起；它们会跑掉，躲进页岩的裂缝里，慢慢散开、消失。我更像是个与它们对话的女智者——我照看它们的脾气与相态。我的笔记本里满是它们的怪癖与无常。想想多奇妙：恰在合适的温度与压力下，物质的连续性就被砸开了？气态的蝴蝶如何从稠密的蠕虫里飞出来？

node.text: After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. 克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。帕克斯·克兰克。我想要求下楼去，可那儿没有蘑菇房。或者有，但正因如此才没有。就像是——「尼克不需要听到这个」。
{{emote|*Neek stares at you awkwardly.*}}
大概就是，我*不会*去喝霍尔滕莎的淤泥汤样品。我喝过一次，她看见了我，只是得体地笑了笑，可我看得出她心里在喊「哇哦哦哦哦哦」，所以我不喝了。尼克朝你眨眼！哈哈哈。她知道我还是会喝。
尼克，念诵：「方——形——头——发！方——形——头——发！方——形——头——发！」大概就像史前蜥蜴会长出大帆来调节体温，而你会说：「我喜欢，可它看着太有机生成了。要是把它锉成一个利落的矩形呢？」

那是一座大熊的城市，有很多书、刮花的黄铜，还有奇怪的响声。可要是你跟着那些响声一起念诵，奥索会让你安静。大概是这样的，让我说明一下。伊塞帕在打盹，所以你就偷看她房间，把她的纸重新排一遍。然后你走过走廊，说「叮叮」，于是马费奥摇摇头，回你一声「叮」。然后你从霍尔滕莎旁边「沫沫」地过去。你就那么「沫沫」地径直过去。你也抱抱她。然后你挪过去抱抱斯帕拉。然后你挪到哈科博那儿，从他肩后看过去，这样点点头。{{emote|*尼克若有所思地点点头。*}}

你跑去冲向Q女郎，把所有的机件都拍一遍，再拍她的头。然后你溜过奥索的办公室。然后你抱抱谢姆-1，把他们拖到图书馆，念书给他们听。有时巴拉瑟鲁姆和霍尔滕莎也在那儿，他们会朝你笑。然后你饿了，就滚向厨房。你从罐子里吸蜂蜜，达尔迪瞪你。你说：「我逗——你玩的。」然后你爬上管道，对阿洛伊修斯低声说：「活着，畅饮，活着，畅饮，活着，畅饮。」然后你拍拍那些铬崽的头。你对埃列什基伽勒说：「砰——砰——砰——砰——砰，我爱你。」然后你溜进库房，把所有的铬崽都拍一遍头。你在消化椅上打个盹。然后你灵光一闪，回自己房间把它写进笔记本。

node.text: 收留神秘的克兰克，何等新奇！我听过关于这位修补匠菌子的故事，没有一个是乏味的——虽说「灾难性」可以形容其中不止一桩。我的脑子在编造地下室里正在酝酿什么的故事，但我很庆幸自己在上头，而不是在下面。
node.choice: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.

node.text: 若换作别人这么说，我会请他把接下来的玩笑留给我。可换成你呢？就算你戴着某位苏丹的殓面回来、还一路毁掉了六只无敌的智天使，我也不会吃惊。愿命运与你同在。
node.choice: I thank you. Live and drink.

node.text: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?
node.choice: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.
Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?
What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?
Did you feel that rumbling, Mafeo?
Have you ever met Pax Klanq?
What kind of creature are you?

node.text: 向你的嗅觉致哀，=player.formalAddressTerm=。各各他在不止一个方面都是个恶劣之地，我劝你若无充足的藜麦与蜂蜜就别去。若你会烹饪，一道含藜麦的饭食能在疾病成形之前把它驱走。也带上药膏或乌尔莓，在下水道里当心你的脚。
Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?
那地方很美，芭蕉也好吃。至于那位所谓的伯爵，嗯。我本来就不愿承认贵族，而我也分不清阿斯福德尔自封头衔，是比继承头衔更好还是更坏。
除了炸药或重型器械，没有东西能发出那种声响。做好最坏的准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
彩虹林对闲步而言危险了些，可它的美无可比拟。我曾乘旋翼机从上方俯瞰它，所见之景我永不会忘。我也不会忘记因为旋翼机坏掉而摔到地上——可每一场冒险都有它的波折，你不觉得吗？
哦，我卖各种合乎我质量标准的杂货，多少经过一番拣选。我尽量让货架上什么都有一些，但你可以指望在此找到足够多的弹药，以及几台能在难时带你回到这里的返回器。若你有东西需要鉴定或修理，我也能代为处理，收几德拉姆（dram）即可。
哎呀，这地方就是砂砾门！哦，那拱顶的厅堂、铬色的闪光、链式炮位低低的嗡鸣！整个卡德（Qud）没有第二处像砂砾门，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我在相对短暂的岁月里也旅行过，但总会回到这里。这里的空气本身就嗡鸣着知识——还有不少别的东西。
我们被称作乌尔希布，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我们这一族比普通的熊聪明，也更机敏，还更手巧一些。

text.text: 活着，畅饮。
什么事？
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

node.choice: Why did you come to Omonporch?

node.text: To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.
[The Baetyl emits an almost subliminal glow.]

choice.IfFinishedQuestStep: Decoding the Signal~Get Q Girl's Instructions onto the Data Disk
choice.CompleteQuestStep: Decoding the Signal~Decode the Signal

start.choice: Why are you hiding in the bush?
Your twinblades are works of art. Where did you get them?

conversation.node: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.

node.text: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.
node.choice: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?

node.text: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.

conversation.node: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.

start.text: Friend! Guns? Knives? Hats? Cucumbers?
start.choice: You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?
What are you? What's your story?

node.text: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.
是的，植物财团。我们是一个商贾同盟，由树木、藤蔓、灌木、杂草、花、香草、仙人掌、藻类组成——基本上是各类植物。我不能说我相信他们中的任何一个，但他们的用处毋庸置疑。我的货架是满的，闲话也在流动。
{{emote|*尤尔不快地弹了一下叶子。*}} 那真菌呢？
node.choice: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?

node.text: {{emote|*尤尔弹了好几下叶子。*}} 不。店关了。活着，畅饮。
我是株文雅植物，-朋友-。把你的根解开，自己想明白。活着，畅饮。
社交名流阿斯福德尔？还是无赖阿斯福德尔？你可以恨伊——我也恨——可你不得不佩服伊（我不佩服）。实情是：最先起意的是普吕萨戈，依循阿布拉姆时代确立的某条法律先例，宣称对纺锤（the Spindle）的所有权。当然，普吕萨戈如今不在场为自己辩白了，是吧？
node.choice: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?

node.text: 阿斯福德尔靠名声与人情做买卖。伊多半会想借用你的人脉，所以你得在几个派系里都有好名声，伊才会考虑。另一条路：若你受财团爱戴，伊会感到必须让步的压力。伊在植物中间树敌够多了。当然，万般皆不灵时，你总可以磨快你的剪刀——你懂我的意思。{{emote|*尤尔用一片叶子眨了眨眼。*}}
node.choice: I see. Live and drink, Yurl.

start.text: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!
start.choice: Why do you call it "your" village?
What can you tell me about Kyakukya?
Is there work to be found here?
Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.

conversation.node: I am at your service.
Correct!

node.text: 啊，坏习惯。这种占有式的感觉，也许我该努力把它从自己身上刷掉？可我是它的镇长，而且已经当了很久。你看，多年前我离开了我的族人。我们想法不同——他们只想把一切都砸死，而我问：「我们砸的这东西，其本性是什么？砸这个行为本身，又是什么？」我明白我的答案在别处，便投身于荒野的涌浪，就像一个没有风巫的珀斯水手，把自己的船交给苍白海的任性！

conversation.node: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.

node.text: 我们靠河雾的水气过活——采林中的果子，也打猎。奥博罗库鲁的信徒则削木头、沉思。你不去问他们，他们便不理你。在这里，你可以与朋友相聚，也可以独自冥想。若你感兴趣的是货物，就去西北角看看尤尔的货。还有那古怪的「鸦歌」的摊子——如果你能在灌木里认出他们。但我必须警告你：别在这片地面上投下恶人的影子。看守英德里克斯会盯着。

conversation.node: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.
Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.

Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.
A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.
As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.
I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?

node.text: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.

conversation.node: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.
Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

node.text: 卡库基亚从未如此喧闹。这些黏液人看来和任何好公民一样，可我已经到了极限——事事都要盯着，压力太大。请过些时候再来看看，等我重新把心神收拢。
再次问候你，=name=。我很高兴报告：黏液人的安顿大体顺利。村民们仍有戒心，但随着一些黏液人加入了奥博罗库鲁的仪式与崇拜，那份戒心已稍减。他们这些日子在村里各处安了家。鸦歌已把打猎的基础教给了少数几个，而我一挤出时间就要开一门烹饪课。
Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.
node.choice: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?

node.text: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.
That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?
node.choice: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?

node.text: ……壮实了点，是吧？
Is. Was naphtaali once.
node.choice: Let us speak of something else.

node.text: Mmm. Have cider?
A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.
node.choice: Let us speak of something else.

node.text: 就像树冠本身，他们会的。谢谢你。
node.choice: Let us speak of something else.

node.text: 朝圣者，被需要、敬畏与灵感聚到一起。修补匠、焊工、守卫、斥候，在毕生事业的压力下熔成一体。算是家人。
不知道。毁了？跑了？我爬走了，再没回头。就这些。
Klanq puff at you. =MARKOVSENTENCE=

start.text: Klanq puff at you?
start.choice: Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?
Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?

choice.IfNotFinishedQuestStep: Pax Klanq, I Presume?~Convince Pax Klanq to Construct the Climber

start.choice: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.

node.text: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.
Klanq distribute! Here, there.
Klanq puff at you.
Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.
Prickles? Klanq miss prickles.
node.choice: Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?
Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.

node.text: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.
Klanq care little for debt.
node.choice: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.

node.text: Klanq puff on debt.
node.choice: Is there anything I can do change your mind?

node.text: Klanq think...
Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.
node.choice: Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.

node.text: 克兰克喷你。你寄宿克兰克。你为克兰克传播克兰克。然后你的克兰克枯萎而去。克兰克喷你，然后克兰克造破车。
Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.

start.text: 克兰克喷你…………以后。现在，克兰克暂停喷，去帮刺刺的忙。
start.choice: 我已准备好让那造物被塑形并催化。
Can you tell me about the components I must gather?
What should I know about the Creature?
Do you live in Grit Gate now?
I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.

node.text: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.
Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?

choice.part: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.
You don't have enough primordial soup.

node.text: Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.
No! Be back =mound.complete.days=.
Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!
node.choice: Tell me about the power source.
Where do I place components once they are gathered?
I have something else to ask.

node.text: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.
Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.
Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.
Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.
Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.
Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.
Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.
Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.
Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.
What ask! Klanq say.
node.choice: I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?
I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?
Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?
What if it's damaged or destroyed?
I have something else to ask.

node.text: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.
Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.
Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.
Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.
Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.
Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?
Make haste, traveller.
node.choice: I am in search of work.

node.text: Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?
node.choice: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.
Where will I find him again?

node.text: Live and drink, traveler.
Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.
node.choice: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?
I am in search of work.

node.text: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.
node.choice: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

node.text: I will ravage your nubile heart!
Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?

There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?
node.choice: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?
Yes. Is there anything else I should know?

node.text: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.
node.choice: Is there anything else I should know?

node.text: 有。第一，马蒙多半有几个羊民受他蛊惑，他们会不惜一切保护他。第二，务必别进马蒙的触及范围——他的手能碰到你时，他的力量最强。第三，取回棱晶之后，无论如何都不要挥舞它。若你带着那件符物回到我面前会产生什么后果，我就不必多说了。就这些。你愿意吗？
node.choice: No, I would risk too much.

node.text: Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.
Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.
node.choice: ［把紫红棱晶交给看守英德里克斯］

node.text: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.
node.choice: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

node.text: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.
node.choice: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

node.text: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!
node.choice: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

node.text: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.
液体更好。我更偏爱液体。
算是液体的鉴赏家。当然，我也涉猎别的物态。可我更偏爱那无角之动的流转与翻滚。不太热，不太冷，也不太不定。

node.IfNotFinishedQuestStep: The Earl of Omonporch~Secure the Spindle
node.text: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.
node.choice: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?
Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.

node.text: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.

Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.
node.choice: So you say. How can I appease you?

node.text: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.
node.choice: 听我说，阿斯福德尔。我是财团的挚友。请你重新考虑。
那就召开议会吧。我愿意。
Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.

node.CompleteQuestStep: The Earl of Omonporch~Secure the Spindle
node.text: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.
node.choice: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.

node.IfFinishedQuestStep: The Earl of Omonporch~Secure the Spindle
node.text: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.
正是。我把纺锤（the Spindle）场租给了你的朋友们，并任命你为总督，监督他们的运作。欢迎入朝，阿斯福德尔派。你随我心意而效力。
Are you ready to begin negotiations?
That was awful!
node.choice: I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.

node.text: Your friends may lease the Spindle, as we agreed.
Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.

text.text: 在岩石前跪下，=player.offspringTerm=。
正如燃烧的太阳温暖着虚空，岩石也温暖着我们。
在此处，并蒙赐予。
呃？
高个子民。
你在游荡？机灵点。
枝条为你让路。
机灵点，宽指。
要什么吗？
嗯，嗯，嗯。
哦欸？
愿树木遮蔽你。
愿播种者之眼越过你。
采撷丰盛。
有危险，呃？
要机灵。
要手稳如焊。
你的祷团在哪儿？
向神首躬身。
没有羊人？
呃，是的。
愿播种者之眼越过你。
去寻铬吧，孤零之人。
啊，孤零之人。
愿神首受福——我们压光祂、高举祂。
愿树木遮蔽你。

node.text: {{emote|*Oboroqoru, Ape God ignores you and muses.*}}
{{emote|*The apple farmer's daughter shies away from you.*}}
{{emote|*soft growling*}}

text.text: 活着，畅饮。
什么事？
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
月与日。
嘿？
你好啊。
都好吧？
沼泽很慷慨。
活下去，喝足水，水之手。
不想惹麻烦。
水藤长势不错，看见没？肥厚的藤饼。
要水藤吗？
你收的，归你。
今年收成好。
要出去？当心鳄鱼。
活下去，喝足水，旅人。
活下去，喝足水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
月与日；智慧与意志。
愿大地这一季为我们出产。

node.text: {{emote|*The crystal chimes in bright tones.*}}
Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?
Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.

conversation.node: The slynth? What of them?

node.text: 活着，畅饮，外客。我是女族长凯；欢迎来到贝拉。像你这样的存在能不惊动我们的斥候便走到这里，几乎前所未有——不过眼下本就是前所未有的时局。我有一件差事交给你。有兴趣吗？
很好。我们欣德伦是个紧密而持重的族群，我们的安全系于团结。为保住安全与文化，我们要求：凡离我们而去者，永不得归来。近来，正是这样一个流放者，在离开时带走了我们村庄的宝物——一只名为金德里什（Kindrish）的手镯。我们之中无人能外出取回它，否则便违背了我以及我之前历代女族长守护了无数世代的准则。你愿意帮我们寻回宝物吗？我们有一小批值钱之物可作报酬。
node.choice: All right. I'll find your treasure.
No thank you. I don't care for this job.

node.text: 好极了。我会尽力给你一份令你满意的报酬。尽管她的名字如今在我嘴里像沙子，偷走金德里什（Kindrish）的那个流放者名叫埃斯欣德。她几周前离开，还带走了她的妹妹和弟弟。我不知道她去了哪里，但看守尼拉欣德也许知道——她们幼时是密友。找到那个名叫埃斯欣德的流放者，从她手中取回金德里什，哪怕……哪怕代价是她和她弟妹的性命。金德里什传承了无数世代，它属于我的族人，不属于任何个人。去吧，外客。去与看守尼拉欣德谈，查清埃斯欣德藏身何处。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Petals on the Wind~Investigate Bey Lah

node.text: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.
node.choice: As you say. Live and drink.

node.text: 你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，外客，我十分钦佩。收下这个，算是谢礼。话虽如此，那个流放者必须为她的罪行负责。若你能把这案子查到底，还有更多的报酬给你。
你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，外客，我十分钦佩。收下这个，算是谢礼，还有……嗯。我想你已挣得了在此停留一阵的资格。只是别给幼鹿们什么念头就好。
You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?

node.text: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.

node.text: 她离开贝拉，就是自逐。我们的律法规定：凡离我们而去的欣德伦，永不得归来。她明知如此，仍然选择离开。
凯塞欣德是个好孩子。他早年失去双亲，却一直像我的儿子。如今他的斧臂在我力所不及之处依然强健，所以才由他出手。
看守尼拉欣德尽责得令人称许。她不太强势，但也无需强势。她竟会配合这场由外人主导的调查，我很意外——不过她对那个流放者一向心软。
你若去问那个流放者，她一定会编出某种指控，说我视性别为不可撼动的牢笼、说我把它强加于人。她在撒谎。我们族群自古就有双性别的欣德伦，称作{{w|哈廷德}}，受人尊敬，且被奉为圣。在我们的社会里，性别变易有一条正当的途径，那位男性流放者多年前本可采用。他从未采用，所以我不承认他。
诗？我厌恶诗。一个人何必学了写字，却偏要用刻意含混的语言，为了押韵而舍弃明白？那当然不是我的。拿回去。
没了……全没了……
我有种极坏的预感：是我把厄运带给了我的村子。也许雇了你本就是个错误。
node.choice: If you say so. Live and drink.

node.text: 他们合谋对付我。这是唯一的解释。你！别来烦我。

node.choice: You will find a way. Live and drink.

node.text: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?
node.choice: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.

node.text: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.
Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.
I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?
But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.
Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.
Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.
Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.
There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.
Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.
That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.
No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.
No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.
Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.
I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.
I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.
I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.
Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.
Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.
I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.
No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.
哦。是的，这确实说明发生过某种=motive.influence=，而=thief.name|strip=一直在试图掩盖。所以你的意思是……
node.choice: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!

node.text: 证据确凿。埃斯欣德违背圣律与族人之意，从贝拉偷走了名为金德里什（Kindrish）的宝物。她将被剥夺荣誉、剥夺水，并从我们的口传史中除名。她的名字再也不会在此被提起，她也永远不得归来……违者处死。而我……我会随她同去。愿我的财产抵偿她给族人造成的伤害；能走在她身旁，我甘愿付出这个代价。我毫不怀疑，贝拉在我离开后会如我当上看守之前那般兴旺。活着，畅饮，我的族人。愿女族长凯长久统领你们。

choice.CompleteQuestStep: Love and Fear~Return the Love Sonnet

node.text: 外客，你必须明白。我花了那么多年，徒劳地想不再爱埃斯欣德。看着她对别的欣德伦笨拙求爱，我以为那是熬过我们少年时代的唯一办法。我也以为那是熬过她离去的唯一办法。可如今她回到了我身边，我不会再失去她，绝不会因为我自己的软弱而失去。

node.text: 凯非常有智慧，也非常谨慎，这弥补了她体力上的不足，以及……手腕上的欠缺。她总是知道什么是对的，而且管得很严。她最讨厌活儿留下的凌乱，自己弄乱的都会收拾干净——除非是洒出来的东西，那就让凯塞欣德去擦。那是因为大母鹿极度害怕积水，绝不肯碰。铜与青铜会让她起过敏疮，所以她碰不得。她太老了，没法与我切磋，但她的弓臂依旧精准。我能想到的就这些。

node.text: 哦。她嘛，她是个信念坚定的好人，至少一直看起来如此。我想这没什么用。埃斯克对细节很敏锐。她非常讨厌水藤，讨厌到绕着水藤田走，吃马兹饼非要配拉赫汤才咽得下。呃，她还怕盐。
node.choice: I have another question, if you please.

node.text: 凯塞欣德对大母鹿绝对忠诚。我们曾是朋友，但自从他被指认为她的守护者，脾气就变得极坏，如今对我相当冷淡。他在暗处看不太清。他持有「阿里」——一柄永不破损的祖传火斧，而且用得极为娴熟。他对吃食挑剔得可怕。他只吃淡味的东西和肉，而且……哦！他幼鹿时咳得厉害，一位照护者想喂他吃藜麦，他一脚踢过去，把她的下巴踢脱了臼。可怜的埃塞尔欣德长老。
node.choice: I have another question, if you please.

start.text: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?

Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so happy! Live and drink.
=name=, it is good to see you. Rest and sup before you move on.

Live and drink, kendren.
我得承认，=name=，对我的族人来说，很少有比「欢迎一支花之民进入我们的镇子」更难以接受的提议了。有些人会视他们如会走路的拉赫。可如果这提议是你提的，他们也许愿意付诸表决。
我会让看守尼拉欣德在大家抽得出空的时候把所有人召集起来。{{emote|*女族长埃斯克小跑而去，声音已经扬了起来。*}} 嘿，看守！
{{emote|The moments pass in hundreds, filled with dust and noise. Voices rise, hooves stamp the packed earth, and a fledgling democratic process takes its first faltering steps.}}
